entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas sighed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia Morgna and Lileas Graf schedule..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia Morgna and Lileas Graf scheduled a meeting to discuss an ongoing legal case that required my attention.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Early in the morning, we convened i..."
entries.dialogueText: Early in the morning, we convened in my office.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Thank you for being here at this h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for being here at this hour, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""There is a court case initiated by..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is a court case initiated by a Bludish citizen which involves a possible revision of the constitution. Unfortunately, it has the potential to affect the whole country."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia stacked the papers in front of..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia stacked the papers in front of her.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""We need to inform you about some n..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to inform you about some news from Bergia."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm listening.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm listening."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Explain, please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Explain, please."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Great. Bad news from Bergia again...."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. Bad news from Bergia again. What's new?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'll start from the beginning. As..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll start from the beginning. As you know, after the discovery of KA-74s in separatist hideouts, there have been more than a few attacks initiated and claimed by the BFF."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""However, with the rising tensions..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, with the rising tensions after Operation Bear Trap, we have also been receiving more and more intelligence about some kind of a 'preparation' by the terrorists."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Due to the decrease of security fu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Due to the decrease of security funds, many of these -- otherwise avoidable -- attacks couldn't be stopped. This created some hysteria inside Bergia."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Thanks to the increase in security..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to the increase in security funding, many of these attacks were stopped before they were executed."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Due to the lack of security fundin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Due to the lack of security funding, some of these -- otherwise avoidable -- attacks couldn't be stopped. This led to some increase in the tensions in Bergia."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Unfortunately, the court backlog i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, the court backlog is piling up with increasingly frequent rulings that are unjust. This has led to many of our citizens losing their trust in our justice system. This is particularly a problem for the residents of Bergia."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""It increased even further after Op..."
entries.dialogueText: "It increased even further after Operation Bear Trap. We have been receiving more and more intelligence about some kind of a 'preparation' by the terrorists."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""It's definitely not helping with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's definitely not helping with the increasing tensions between the Bludish populace and Sords."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is worrying.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is worrying."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think the threat is overblown.""
entries.dialogueText: "I think the threat is overblown."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You have my ear.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have my ear."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""We'll get there, Ms. Morgna. As I..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll get there, Ms. Morgna. As I was saying..."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I agree with you that the threat h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree with you that the threat has been exaggerated. However, the court case that I'm looking ov-"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The increasing threat of the BFF l..."
entries.dialogueText: "The increasing threat of the BFF led Governor Bron to -- justifiably -- resort to his emergency powers to curb the danger."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""His discovery of militant training..."
entries.dialogueText: "His discovery of militant training grounds disguised as schools was commendable, as well as his quick handling of bomb threats coming from major cities like Deyr."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""However, his latest policies have..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, his latest policies have been questionable. Especially the 'Peaceful Resettlement' order. It has been met with massive anger from the majority of the Bluds in the region."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What exactly is this case about?""
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly is this case about?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Ishval Ersen is claiming that the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ishval Ersen is claiming that the current constitution gives the legal grounds to discriminate against Bludish people, directly infringing upon their rights as citizens."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""He claims Article 7 of the constit..."
entries.dialogueText: "He claims Article 7 of the constitution -- citing the line: 'Every Sord is equal before the law' -- is in direct conflict with the freedoms and rights defined in Article 100."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Governor Phelix Bron is accused of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Governor Phelix Bron is accused of using Article 7 to justify his oppression of the Bludish community."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What are the accusations against t..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are the accusations against the governor?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who is Ishval Ersen?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who is Ishval Ersen?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Mr. Bron has sadly evicted thousan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Bron has sadly evicted thousands of Bluds from their homes in Deyr recently. The fact that this happened in a city with relatively low levels of BFF activity is a sloppy decision at best."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""A sloppy decision? This is a direc..."
entries.dialogueText: "A sloppy decision? This is a direct violation of their right to property. The BFF activity levels have nothing to do with this."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""But it does, Ms. Morgna. The state..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it does, Ms. Morgna. The state can take any measures to fight with terror inside its borders. The decision would have been justified if those neighborhoods were in fact labelled as 'threat level red'."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""...But they were not. Hence, he di..."
entries.dialogueText: "...But they were not. Hence, he did not have the authority to evict those citizens. In this case in Deyr, the governor has definitely violated his authority."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""There are hundreds of accusations..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are hundreds of accusations listed in this case, ranging from violent actions by law enforcement officers to open discrimination in local municipalities."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""You are underplaying it. This evic..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are underplaying it. This eviction was only the last of the many he ordered as part of Bergia's *peaceful resettlement policies*. This is not about Deyr."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Ishval Ersen is a lawyer and Bludi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ishval Ersen is a lawyer and Bludish rights activist. He lives in Deyr and has experienced the systemic racism in the region firsthand."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""He was evicted last month from his..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was evicted last month from his home in Deyr on the grounds of 'threatening public stability and safety'."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""He was also shot at by local law e..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was also shot at by local law enforcement forces several times in the last two years and managed to survive it all so far. The attackers, of course, were never punished."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""As much as the eviction seems unju..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as the eviction seems unjust, Mr. Ersen must be further investigated for his potential ties to dangerous organizations. I'd like to believe the forces wouldn't have fired at him without proper reason."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What exactly does Ersen claim abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly does Ersen claim about the conflict in the constitution?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""As you know, the rights and libert..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you know, the rights and liberties Article 7 alludes to are described in Article 100 in further detail."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mr. Ersen claims the line: 'Every..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Ersen claims the line: 'Every Sord is equal before the law' in Article 7 does not include other ethnicities and thus gives the state the right to suspend or limit the rights of non-Sords defined in Article 100."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""All citizens, in theory, can exerc..."
entries.dialogueText: "All citizens, in theory, can exercise their rights described in these articles and are equally subject to law as described, and these rights cannot be suspended by the government under any circumstances other than a defensive war."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Courts have repeatedly protected G..."
entries.dialogueText: "Courts have repeatedly protected Governor Bron in the past, and it is true that he bets on Mr. Hawker justifying his actions through Article 7. However, there is also Article 6 -- which the courts could have taken into account already."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And what is the problem with Artic..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what is the problem with Article 6?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Article 7 is an embarrassment that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Article 7 is an embarrassment that needs to be removed. I wish we could also tackle this in our proposal for constitutional change."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Explain.""
entries.dialogueText: "Explain."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'm not sure how you'd manage that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure how you'd manage that at this stage of the process."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""As you know, Article 6 goes: 'Ever..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you know, Article 6 goes: 'Everyone who is bound to the Sordish state by citizenship is a Sord'."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""But did you ask Bludish people wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "But did you ask Bludish people what they think? Yes, it's true that this article has protected them on a number of occasions, as it defines Sord as a non-ethnic term, but it is left up to the interpretation of the courts."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Which clarifies clearly that the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which clarifies clearly that the constitution does not discriminate against other ethnicities or cultures. Citizens of this country are called Sords."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""They could have argued that Articl..."
entries.dialogueText: "They could have argued that Article 6 extends the rights defined in Article 7 to all citizens of Sordland regardless of race. But they didn't. Yet."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is getting very complicated.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is getting very complicated."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'll try to keep it simple.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll try to keep it simple."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""That is a massive understatement...."
entries.dialogueText: "That is a massive understatement. Governor Bron has abused his powers and clearly acted against the constitution."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""And quite surprisingly, Ishval Ers..."
entries.dialogueText: "And quite surprisingly, Ishval Ersen has managed to successfully push his case to the higher courts. He is suing Phelix Bron for infringing upon the liberties of Bludish people."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""He also raises a conflict in the c..."
entries.dialogueText: "He also raises a conflict in the constitution and argues that the way it is written makes it open to interpretation and allows people like Governor Bron to abuse their powers."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""It wasn't a possibility according..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wasn't a possibility according to the preliminary committee meetings."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""But there might be a way around it..."
entries.dialogueText: "But there might be a way around it in the near future."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""They can potentially push this cas..."
entries.dialogueText: "They can potentially push this case to the Supreme Court."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I have enough information.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have enough information."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""In any case... The situation might..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case... The situation might be troubling if it reaches the Supreme Court and Mr. Hawker manages to sabotage it by altering the current interpretation. It would be disastrous for Bludish rights."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I will be doing my best to ensure..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be doing my best to ensure a positive result comes out of this case. But I'm not sure if the centrists would be willing to agree with Mr. Ersen."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Why would Mr. Hawker even sabotage..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why would Mr. Hawker even sabotage it? The current interpretation is strictly Sollist. I'm sure he will follow the constitution and charge Governor Bron for unconstitutional behavior."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""According to the foundational valu..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the foundational values of this republic, everyone who is a citizen of this country is a Sord. The constitution is clear about this and does not allow for discrimination."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Maybe Hawker is not the man you th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe Hawker is not the man you think he is, Ms. Graf. From what I've heard, his stance on this subject may not be the standard Sollist interpretation but... something darker."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'm afraid he'll reject the case a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid he'll reject the case altogether and find Governor Bron innocent. If this happens, it would make discrimination against Bludish people legal."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you think Justice Hawker and th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think Justice Hawker and the Old Guards would go that far?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What if we can convince the Justic..."
entries.dialogueText: "What if we can convince the Justices to agree with Ersen? Wouldn't that give us precedent to change said articles of the constitution?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is insane. Isn't there anythi..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is insane. Isn't there anything I can do?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""According to the rumors within the..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the rumors within the Supreme Court, yes. It is already unusual that the case is making its way up to them."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""If the Supreme Court agrees that t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the Supreme Court agrees that the constitution is in conflict with itself, yes... But I don't know if you are serious or not, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'm afraid not, Mr. President. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid not, Mr. President. The executive has no jurisdiction over the judiciary."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You must put pressure on the syste..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must put pressure on the system and block this case from reaching the Supreme Court, Ms. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'm afraid even Justice Edmonds an..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid even Justice Edmonds and the centrists would be completely against that. It would be a very difficult scenario."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""And in this case, I'm afraid even..."
entries.dialogueText: "And in this case, I'm afraid even Justice Edmonds and the centrists would be almost impossible to convince."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Of course. I will do my best, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. I will do my best, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""To be honest, I don't think this i..."
entries.dialogueText: "To be honest, I don't think this is a matter for our administration. We must keep out from judicial affairs."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Honestly, I couldn't care less. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, I couldn't care less. It would be better for this country."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia recoiled with shock."
entries.dialogueText: Nia recoiled with shock.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I hope you are joking, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you are joking, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What the Bludish community is goin..."
entries.dialogueText: "What the Bludish community is going through in Bergia is unacceptable. We must do what it takes to stop this madness."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ms. Graf is right. We must first b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Graf is right. We must first be completely sure that Mr. Ersen is innocent."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you joking, Ms. Graf? You'd li..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you joking, Ms. Graf? You'd like to *believe*? The police are getting out of control under your management."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""What's that supposed to mean? I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's that supposed to mean? I'm not even in control of the forces that are being blamed here. Governor Bron has his own security forces."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""That we must.""
entries.dialogueText: "That we must."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I will look into it, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will look into it, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""My forces were not involved in any..."
entries.dialogueText: "My forces were not involved in any of this. It was Bergian police. Bergia's special zone is what allowed this to happen in the first place."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""As much as I hate to say it, I som..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as I hate to say it, I somewhat agree with Lileas on this. I'd prefer to keep the status quo over risking a complete abolishment of rights. We still have the power to make tangible reforms."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your lack of faith is disappointin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your lack of faith is disappointing. I must say I didn't expect that from you. And what about your tangible reforms?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'm simply stating the obvious, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm simply stating the obvious, Mr. President. Instead of openly attacking the court, we can bring real change with our lawmaking powers."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""As I said, I think the government..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said, I think the government has better things to do than meddle with judicial affairs."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""There is, however, something that..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is, however, something that the government can do to address the situation on the ground."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""It is time we push for change with..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is time we push for change within the security structure of Bergia and the special status that resulted in de facto autonomy. It clearly isn't working."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""The resettlement policies in Bergi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The resettlement policies in Bergia and the Ersen case have changed the mood of the lawmakers. We can use this opportunity to push for the removal of Tarquin Soll's security zone decree. It is a much bigger possibility than before."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Ms. Morgna is right. There is some..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ms. Morgna is right. There is something that the government can do to address the situation on the ground."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Of course racism is rampant throug..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course racism is rampant throughout our country, but Bludish citizens inside Bergia are having a much worse time than the Bludish residents of cities like Lachaven or Holsord. If we focus on Bergia, we can remove its special status."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""This alone would be a huge step fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "This alone would be a huge step for Bludish rights. Unfortunately, as long as Governor Bron is in charge of Bergia with the powers he has, no judicial reforms would reverse the situation on the ground."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""To put it simply, we want to work..."
entries.dialogueText: "To put it simply, we want to work on a detailed proposal to restructure Bergia. I believe it must become a region of Sordland like any other. We must centralize the system and abolish the local security forces."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you absolutely certain that yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you absolutely certain that your security forces can do a better job than Bergian police?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't see how a local change is..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see how a local change is more important than removing the basis of discrimination in our very constitution."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you sure we can even revoke th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure we can even revoke the special status of Bergia?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You are right. We shouldn't meddle..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are right. We shouldn't meddle in the judiciary."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't agree with changing the st..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't agree with changing the structure in Bergia now. We shouldn't disrupt Governor Bron's policies."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We can't be sure of anything, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't be sure of anything, Mr. President. You know this better than me."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""It is true. Some members of my cir..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is true. Some members of my circle inside the party are keen on this as well. They are starting to believe Soll's policy in Bergia has already run its course."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""But Lileas and I both believe ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Lileas and I both believe there is potential to get more MPs behind the idea."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""It is discouraging to hear this fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is discouraging to hear this from you, Mr. President. My team and our officers on the ground are comprised of the most well-trained and patriotic individuals."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""With Bergia under complete control..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Bergia under complete control of the central administration, we will no longer hear about reports of injustice against our Bludish citizens."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""We can't allow the conflict in Weh..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't allow the conflict in Wehlen to spread to Sordland. And we know that the Wehlen and Sordland divisions of the BFF are in close cooperation."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Well, Mr. President, if your insan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Mr. President, if your insane proposal somehow makes it, your new powers would allow you to enact this by decree anyway."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""If we play our cards right during..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we play our cards right during the process of this case while we work on the preparation of a strong proposal for the special zone, we can gather enough support behind it."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Well, Mr. President, with a strong..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Mr. President, with a strong enough proposal and some judicial support, your current powers might be just enough to be able to enact this by decree as well."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We have to try.""
entries.dialogueText: "We have to try."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""In any case, I think it is also po..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, I think it is also possible to get this through the Assembly."

entries.dialogueText: Lileas Graf scheduled a meeting with me to discuss some important matters about the Special Zone of Bergia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She came to my office early in the..."
entries.dialogueText: She came to my office early in the morning.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Thank you for being here at this h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for being here at this hour, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I need to inform you about some ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need to inform you about some news from Bergia."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm listening.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm listening."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Explain, please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Explain, please."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Great. Bad news from Bergia again...."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. Bad news from Bergia again. What's new?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'll start from the beginning. As..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll start from the beginning. As you know, after the discovery of KA-74s in separatist hideouts, there have been more than a few attacks initiated and claimed by the BFF."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas sighed.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Due to the decrease in security fu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Due to the decrease in security funding, many of these -- otherwise avoidable -- attacks couldn't be stopped. This created some hysteria inside Bergia."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Thanks to the emergency laws givin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to the emergency laws giving authority to our forces, many of these attacks were stopped before they could be executed."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Thanks to the increase in security..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to the increase in security funding, many of these attacks were stopped before they could be executed."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The main problem, however, lies wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The main problem, however, lies with the security structure of Bergia. Due to the special status of the region, operations on the ground are run by local security forces that are not bound to the Interior."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Which means my hands are tied.""
entries.dialogueText: "Which means my hands are tied."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Due to the lack of security fundin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Due to the lack of security funding, some of these -- otherwise avoidable -- attacks couldn't be stopped. This led to some increase in the tensions in Bergia."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""During an emergency, no less.""
entries.dialogueText: "During an emergency, no less."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The threat of the BFF is growing l..."
entries.dialogueText: "The threat of the BFF is growing larger, and we cannot respond efficiently if the Governor of the Special Zone doesn't cooperate with my forces."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""We cannot continue our fight again..."
entries.dialogueText: "We cannot continue our fight against the targets of the emergency if the Governor of the Special Zone doesn't cooperate with my forces."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I must also add... With the rising..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must also add... With the rising tensions after Operation Bear Trap, we have also been receiving more and more intelligence about some kind of a 'preparation' by the terrorists."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""We can't allow the conflict in Weh..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't allow the conflict in Wehlen to spread to Sordland. And we know that both the Wehlen and Sordland divisions of the BFF are in close cooperation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is worrying.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is worrying."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You have my ear.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have my ear."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's precisely why I didn't make..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's precisely why I didn't make a deal with Wehlen."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's precisely why we joined the..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's precisely why we joined the operation. To destroy the BFF once and for all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's precisely why we're coopera..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's precisely why we're cooperating with Wehzek forces to defend our borders."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I think this is overblown. The Blu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think this is overblown. The Bludish are not the targets of our emergency. I don't want to lose sight of our real targets."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I must say that could have helped..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must say that could have helped in this situation. Even though I myself was against the deal at the time."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You're wrong, Mr. President. Even..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're wrong, Mr. President. Even if the Bluds weren't your original targets, Governor Bron is using your emergency declaration as a justification to wage war against them."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Maybe you were right about that de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe you were right about that decision, after all."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Using your emergency declaration a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Using your emergency declaration as a justification, Governor Bron is declaring war on the Bludish people with his powers as governor of the Special Zone."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Feeling bolstered by the increasin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Feeling bolstered by the increasing threat of the BFF, Governor Bron is declaring war on the Bludish people with his powers as governor of the Special Zone."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I know this is already what you wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know this is already what you wanted, Mr. President. But I don't think we can have Governor Bron in charge of the emergency there. He is going completely rogue."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""In short, he's ignored your origin..."
entries.dialogueText: "In short, he's ignored your original targets and gone completely rogue."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I'm afraid he has gone rogue, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid he has gone rogue, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""But I believe it is time we push f..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I believe it is time we push for change within the security structure of Bergia. Its special status resulted in de facto autonomy, which clearly isn't working."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Unfortunately, he is under protect..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, he is under protection due to the absurd laws of the Special Zone. The Supreme Court doesn't want to move against him."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's not the point. There is a r..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's not the point. There is a reason why Bergia is a Special Zone. We cannot simply act like the secessionist movement doesn't exist."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you absolutely certain that yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you absolutely certain that your security forces can do a better job than Bergian police?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How do we revoke the special statu..."
entries.dialogueText: "How do we revoke the special status of Bergia?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't agree with changing the st..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't agree with changing the structure in Bergia now. We shouldn't disrupt Governor Bron's policies."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""We can't be sure of anything, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't be sure of anything, Mr. President. You know this better than me."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Some of my circle inside the party..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some of my circle inside the party are actually keen on this as well. They are starting to believe Soll's policy in Bergia has already run its course."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""But with the extreme actions of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "But with the extreme actions of the governor, I believe there is a way to get more MPs behind the idea."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""It is discouraging to hear this fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is discouraging to hear this from you, Mr. President. My team and our officers on the ground comprise only the most well-trained and patriotic individuals."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""With Bergia under complete control..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Bergia under complete control of the central administration, we will no longer hear reports of injustice against our Bludish citizens."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Are you truly supportive of Govern..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you truly supportive of Governor Bron's policies, Mr. President?"

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""So here's my offer. I'll work on t..."
entries.dialogueText: "So here's my offer. I'll work on the proposal for abolishing the Special Zone of Bergia."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""This would also mean abolishing th..."
entries.dialogueText: "This would also mean abolishing the region's special governor position."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Please. Hear me out.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please. Hear me out."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't want to move against a pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to move against a prominent USP figure who's protected by Mr. Hawker right now. I'm sure you understand."

entries.title: Player: ""No. But I don't want my administra..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. But I don't want my administration to be involved in such a politically charged issue."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""But the reality is that we need to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the reality is that we need to address the security problems in Bergia. This Bludish issue has the potential to get out of hand."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. I think he's doing a good job.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I think he's doing a good job."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I thought the same at first. But i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought the same at first. But it's clearly not working. The Governor is following his own independent policies, which is detrimental for the country as a whole."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I see. I understand your concern,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. I understand your concern, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I would have agreed with you sever..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would have agreed with you several years ago, Mr. President. But the policies of the governor are clearly not working."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I want us to abolish the Special Z..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want us to abolish the Special Zone and turn Bergia into a region like any other -- giving my security forces full authority over it."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""We just need to prepare a comprehe..."
entries.dialogueText: "We just need to prepare a comprehensive plan and proposal for it."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""You can enact it with your emergen..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can enact it with your emergency powers when it's ready, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""With Bergia under complete control..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Bergia under complete control of the central administration, we will no longer have failed operations or rogue governors to worry about."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""With Bergia under complete control..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Bergia under complete control of the central administration, we can efficiently enforce the emergency and bring stability to the region."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am all for it, Lileas. I support..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am all for it, Lileas. I support this idea."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""That's lovely to hear, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's lovely to hear, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""We will hold local municipal elect..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will hold local municipal elections just like every city in Sordland, and regional security will be under the full control of the Ministry of the Interior. We will no longer allow Bergia to have its own security force that defies orders from the central government."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Regional security will be under th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regional security will be under the full control of the Ministry of the Interior. We will no longer allow Bergia to have its own security force that defies orders from the central government."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""And we will hold local municipal e..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we will hold local municipal elections just like every other city in Sordland. Probably not before the emergency period ends, of course..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All right. I will support you. Sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. I will support you. Start working on it immediately."

entries.dialogueText: "No, I will not support this proposal, Ms. Graf. I'd rather keep the Special Zone as it is."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf

entries.dialogueText: "I knew you would see reason, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf

entries.dialogueText: "I will start working on the proposal immediately. It is very important to get this right, so it will take some time."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf

entries.dialogueText: "My estimate is that it will be ready sometime after our midterm cabinet meeting."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sounds good, Ms. Graf. I'm countin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds good, Ms. Graf. I'm counting on you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Great. Get to work immediately.""
entries.dialogueText: "Great. Get to work immediately."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.dialogueText: She bid her farewell and left the room.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf

entries.dialogueText: "Great. I'll get to work. See you later, Mr. President."

entries.dialogueText: "This only makes my job harder."

entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the meeting nonetheless."
